name: Agriculture Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public agriculture data.

entries.title: Eurostat Agriculture Database
entries.description: Eurostat's official EU agricultural statistics — farm structure and agricultural census, crop and animal production, agricultural prices and economic accounts, and agri-environmental indicators — harmonised across EU member states.

coverage.spatial: EU member states (some EFTA and candidate countries); regional (NUTS) breakdowns for some tables

entries.license: CC-BY-4.0 (Eurostat copyright notice and free re-use of data)
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page lists the Agriculture data navigation tree, agricultural census, and agri-environmental indicators. Eurostat's copyright notice (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/help/copyright-notice) licenses its content under CC BY 4.0 and states the ESS policy of free statistics regardless of use. API and bulk access go through Eurostat's general dissemination services.
Cadence varies by table, from monthly price series to the decennial agricultural census; recorded as irregular for the collection.

entries.title: FAOSTAT
entries.description: The UN Food and Agriculture Organization's global statistical database covering agricultural production, trade, land use, and food security for nearly every country and territory.
entries.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
entries.notes: Verified reachable this session (HTTP 200). Bulk downloads available via FAOSTAT's own bulk-download API in addition to the interactive browser. Seeded as this vertical's first international (non-US) source per operator request to seed the new verticals international-first.
